1	# frai-gate
2	
3	The **FRAI Gate** (Responsible AI Gate) for specs - part of [FRAI](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai).
4	
5	Every spec for an AI-touching feature must contain a complete `## FRAI Gate`
6	section - seven checks - and implementation doesn't start until the gate passes:
7	
8	1. Risk tier (EU AI Act-aligned; high-risk requires a named human sign-off)
9	2. Data provenance & privacy
10	3. Human oversight
11	4. Evaluation plan (numeric thresholds)
12	5. Bias & fairness
13	6. Monitoring & rollback
14	7. Transparency & incident response
15	
16	## Usage
17	
18	```bash
19	npx frai-gate init --ci                 # scaffold FRAI-SPEC.md + a GitHub Action that runs
20	                                        # the gate on every PR (works in any repo)
21	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md         # deterministic validation - no API key needed
22	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md --smart # + adversarial AI review of answer quality
23	npx frai-gate draft                     # read-only agent scans the repo and drafts a
24	                                        # gate section grounded in your actual code
25	```
26	
27	Also available as `frai gate ...` from the main [frai CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/frai).
28	
29	Exit codes: `0` PASS/WARN · `1` BLOCK · `2` usage/error - drop `frai-gate check` straight into CI.
30	
31	`draft` and `--smart` run on the [Claude Agent SDK](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk)
32	with read-only tools (`Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`) and need Claude Code authentication or
33	`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Override the model with `FRAI_GATE_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5`).
34	
35	> **Privacy note:** `draft` and `--smart` send the repository content the agent reads to
36	> Anthropic's API. The agent is instructed never to read secret material (`.env`, keys,
37	> certificates, credential stores), but treat that as a mitigation, not a guarantee -
38	> think before running them on highly sensitive repos. `check` without `--smart` makes
39	> no network calls at all.
40	
41	## Programmatic API
42	
43	```ts
44	import { validateSpec, draftGateSection, smartReview } from 'frai-gate';
45	
46	const result = validateSpec(await fs.readFile('FRAI-SPEC.md', 'utf8'));
47	// { verdict: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'BLOCK', tier, findings, gateSection }
48	```
49	
50	The companion agent skill lives in
51	[sebuzdugan/frai-skills](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-skills)
52	(`npx skills add sebuzdugan/frai-skills`).

17 18 # FRAI · Framework of Responsible Artificial Intelligence 19 20 ![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/frai) 21 ![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/frai) 22 23 **Live platform:** [frai.cc](https://www.frai.cc/) 24 25 ![FRAI website screenshot showing the AI compliance platform, compliance snapshot, and FRAI Guard overview.](assets/frai_cc_screenshot.png) 26 27 FRAI is an open-source toolkit that helps teams launch AI features responsibly. It guides you through evidence gathering, scans your code, and assembles documentation you can hand to reviewers: implementation checklists, model cards, risk files, evaluation reports, and compliance-aware RAG indexes. The toolkit ships as four packages that work together: 28 29 - `frai` – the command-line app with ready-to-run workflows. 30 - `frai-core` – the reusable SDK that powers the CLI and any custom integrations. 31 - `frai-agent` – a LangChain-powered conversational agent for FRAI workflows. 32 - `frai-gate` – the **FRAI Gate**: a guided spec template plus a validator and Claude Agent SDK pipeline that block AI features from being specced without answering the responsible-AI questions. (The matching agent skill lives in [frai-skills](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-skills).) 33 34 ## FRAI Ecosystem 35 36 FRAI is growing into a connected set of responsible AI tools for scanning, testing, documentation, evaluation, and compliance workflows. 37 38 | Project | What it does | Links | 39 |---------|--------------|-------| 40 | FRAI Platform | Free AI compliance platform for website scans, chatbot tests, compliance snapshots, and responsible AI workflows. | [Website](https://www.frai.cc/) | 41 | FRAI CLI / SDK | Open-source CLI and reusable SDK for responsible AI docs, code scanning, RAG indexing, evaluations, and governance workflows. | [GitHub](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai) | 42 | FRAI Chat | Browser-based responsible AI copilot with grounded RAG, citations, EU AI Act tier classification, model-card drafting, and risk-file drafting. | [GitHub](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-chat) · [Live demo](https://sebuzdugan.github.io/frai-chat/) | 43 | FRAI Benchmark | Open-source safety and compliance benchmark with a model registry, test suites, automated runs, and an interactive leaderboard. | [GitHub](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-benchmark) · [Leaderboard](https://sebuzdugan.github.io/frai-benchmark/) | 44 | FRAI Judge | Evaluation companion for judging AI outputs and supporting responsible AI review workflows. | [GitHub](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-judge) | 45 | FRAI Skills | Agent skills for responsible AI engineering - the FRAI Gate spec workflow for AI coding agents (`npx skills add sebuzdugan/frai-skills`). | [GitHub](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-skills) | 46 47 ### Short Answer 48 - `frai-core` is the library/SDK. Use it when you are embedding FRAI capabilities into your own tools, servers, automations, or extensions. 49 - `frai` is the CLI.
